reviews.text: My cat Nougat had an appointment on September 8, 2026. A huge thank you to Dr. Denizet who took care of him with such gentleness and kindness. The next day, Nougat was completely recovered. A huge thank you also to all the veterinary assistants at reception for their smiles and kindness. I highly recommend this clinic.

A huge thank you to the entire team for your warm welcome, kindness, compassion, and professionalism. It's truly rare to find such a caring team. I loved the staff, and above all, a heartfelt thank you for Luna and everything you did for her.

A fantastic team that I wholeheartedly recommend!

I've been a regular patient of Dr. Deniset for years! Never disappointed! She's honest and doesn't push unnecessary treatments! Very rare these days with vets in Paris! Her love for animals comes first.

I strongly advise against this clinic.

I came in as an emergency on a Monday for a groin wound on my cat. A skin wound. Despite this injury, he was walking perfectly normally on all four paws, without the slightest limp. This is a point I want to emphasize, because it's crucial.

Trimming and stitching under general anesthesia cost €360. It was after this procedure, and only after, that he started limping. I reported it. I was told it was normal because of the dressing and stitches... The limp never stopped. I had to return a month later and pay €250 for X-rays to get the real diagnosis: a fractured femur. A fracture that hadn't been seen during the initial visit, even though the animal had been anesthetized, handled, and operated on right there on their operating table.

When I asked how this was possible, they suggested that a cat could break its femur by suddenly jumping out of its litter box. Maybe. But my cat was walking normally when I arrived at their clinic and was limping when I left. At no point did they consider that something might have happened during the initial treatment, and at no point were they offered any assistance whatsoever.

The result: over €600 paid to this clinic for a groin wound, a broken femur diagnosed weeks late, and a surgery to be redone elsewhere at my own expense. They charge exorbitant fees, listen very little, and take no responsibility. Avoid this place.

The team is fantastic. I regularly come here for advice on my obese cat's nutrition, and the lady with pink hair at reception—whom I've often had the pleasure of meeting these past few months—is always patient and kind in the face of my distress regarding my animals' health. The veterinarians are also dedicated and pleasant.

Dr. Denizet has always cared for, saved, and loved my animals…

Thanks to her and her wonderful team, the lives of our little companions are much less sad and much less short.

Dr. Denizet takes her time during appointments, both for the well-being of the animal and for the well-being of its owner… complaining about this would make us bad owners, wouldn't it?

People who "love" their animals with a stopwatch in their hand would do well to look elsewhere… too bad (unfortunately) for the collateral damage to their little ones…
Thank you for being there, Doctor…

Thank you for always going above and beyond…

Thank you for them, for me, and for everyone else…

Bev

For 25 years, my cats and I have been going to the Montsouris clinic. Their competence and kindness are unwavering. The team is incredibly attentive and offers invaluable advice. The veterinarians and veterinary assistants are always available. Thank you to everyone.

An excellent clinic, everyone is attentive and the veterinarians take the time to listen to better understand the needs of our four-legged companions. A very pleasant environment for everyone, and always in a cheerful atmosphere. I highly recommend it for the well-being of our animals.

My two cats were examined by Dr. Tralci for their annual check-up, and both they and I were delighted with the experience. The vet was very gentle with my two fur babies; they remained very relaxed throughout the entire consultation. Nothing was overlooked during the examination, so I left feeling completely reassured!

And a special mention to Roger and Gloria, the clinic's two adorable little mascots.

Avoid at all costs! If you absolutely must go to the Denizet vet clinic, do not go there.

The reception staff is incompetent, and the vet is incompetent and always late. I will never take my dog ​​there again. I found another clinic in the 14th arrondissement that is truly competent and friendly. Don't waste your time; the clinic would be much better off without this vet, as the negative reviews seem to be solely for her.

I absolutely do not recommend this veterinary clinic, and especially not the veterinarian, Dr. Denizet.

I called to make an appointment, and they gave me a time slot, which I carefully noted down. On the day of my appointment, even though I was on time, or even early, the clinic called to tell me I was late. Despite my explanations, they assumed the mistake was entirely my fault.

The person who had an appointment before me had told me just before that they too had been the victim of a scheduling error by the clinic. Despite this, at no point did they consider that the problem might stem from their own organization.

The veterinarian was particularly unpleasant and told me, in a very curt tone, that if I wasn't happy, I could leave when I specified that it was the first and last time I would ever go there (and rightly so, given her attitude). I then reminded her that I had come for my cat's health and that she was obligated to provide him with care. She replied that she did indeed have a duty of care and that she would see him, but her attitude remained haughty and unprofessional throughout the entire exchange.

To top it all off, the clinic doesn't even respect its own appointment times (it's ironic, considering I arrived on time, even early, and they told me I was late, while they themselves don't even bother to check their clients' times and don't even apologize!).

Based on this experience, I strongly advise against this establishment, both for its lack of organization and for its reception and attitude towards clients.

This clinic doesn't deserve one star, but unfortunately, I can't give it zero.

I consulted them for my cat, who ultimately had a fracture that wasn't diagnosed during his initial visit. Despite my concerns, which turned out to be well-founded, my fears were ignored. I was also very shocked that certain medications intended to relieve his pain weren't administered immediately, even though he was clearly in pain. During the consultation, the veterinarian also placed my cat on the examination table in a rather unsafe manner, causing him to fall, despite having a fracture. This situation deeply affected me.

My cat didn't leave the clinic with any treatment, and the costs for consultations at this clinic and then at others recommended by the veterinarian have ultimately proven very expensive for nonexistent care and a lack of diagnosis. I also found the veterinarian's attitude pushy, unpleasant, and guilt-tripping, which made this experience even more difficult.

On the other hand, I want to emphasize that my other cat was treated by a different veterinarian at this clinic, who is outstanding. Kind, attentive, and very professional, she confirmed to me over the phone that it was possible to administer a pill to my cat without any extra charge, and did so very gently.

However, during the second administration of the treatment, another veterinarian agreed to perform the same procedure but ultimately charged me an additional €13, even though he had previously told me that this was included in the appointment. €13 extra just to put the pill in my cat's mouth! I find this outrageous and it reveals this individual's lack of consideration for animal welfare. He then explained that the first intervention was a goodwill gesture. I found this situation regrettable, as the information provided was contradictory.

I regret this lack of consistency in the care and communication. My experience with my injured cat remains very disappointing and impactful now that he has died from the consequences of this fracture.

Hello,
My four cats have been under the care of the entire team and Dr. Sauvaget for a year now. Kiki, who was very ill due to the complete neglect of the previous vet in the 15th arrondissement for two years, has regained his vitality, like a 19-year-old senior, thanks to Dr. Sauvaget. I didn't listen to my elderly cat, who, even with sedatives, was terrifyingly aggressive with the previous vet. But with Dr. Sauvaget and his team, he is gentle and calm, as if he knows he's in good hands. The other three cats all have the same calm demeanor, no meowing or stress.

😻😻😻😻

A very friendly and highly competent team.
The vet is skilled and very gentle.
A very good experience every time I visit, the staff are great.
Excellent clinic! Dr. Caroline Paes was very gentle and reassuring with my puppy. The prices are very transparent and honest. I highly recommend them!
A caring, efficient, professional veterinarian who knows how to help! And the prices are very reasonable.
This is the best veterinary clinic in Paris 🤩 …
Perfect! Guizmo approves! 6/5

My kitten has been treated at this clinic since December, and I am so grateful to have found this team.

My cat is a little stray who started out with many health problems and has therefore already had several surgeries and appointments.
The team has taken remarkable care of him, reassuring me and supporting me while pampering my cat.
They are always available, by phone or even for an emergency appointment. They are all there because of their love for animals and a genuine desire to help above all else. Having seen many veterinarians, it's not easy to find such a wonderful team.
I sincerely thank them all.

I've been going to this veterinary clinic since I got my dog, and I trust them completely. The team is always very professional, gentle, and caring with the animals. You truly feel listened to and reassured at every visit.

A big thank you to the whole team for their kindness. I highly recommend them.

This clinic has been my cat's home since he was a kitten. The team is fantastic, always a warm welcome (from both humans and cats), and they give great advice. I love the new decor; the examination rooms are like little houses—it's wonderful.
Adorable and competent, go for it!
The quality of care remains excellent. Warm welcome. Available staff.
The vets are very attentive and the place is welcoming from the moment you open the door.

The clinic was recently renovated and it's a real success. The team is fantastic, both with the animals and their owners. Excellent advice and follow-up. I really think it's a great veterinary clinic.

A veterinary clinic I wholeheartedly recommend! Dr. Sauvaget takes excellent care of my animals, and the entire team is always friendly. The atmosphere has become even more welcoming since the clinic's renovation in August 😊 …

An exceptional team! Always attentive, highly professional, and incredibly caring towards animals. You can feel their genuine passion for their work and their constant concern for the well-being of our companions. Special mention goes to Dr. Denizet, who has always supported me with gentleness and compassion, through both happy and difficult times. Thank you for your care and dedication.

Hello,
Dr. Denizet was very punctual and professional, my dog ​​was delighted with his visit, thank you very much 😘🐩 …
Top-notch care, a wonderful welcome, you can tell they love animals! Many thanks to Dr. Denizet
Excellent experience at this veterinary clinic. Dr. Denizet is patient and reassuring! My dog ​​received perfect care.
Very friendly and good service. Highly recommend!

I came to the clinic for my cat because of a dental issue (it turns out she had gum recession).

The whole team is wonderful: welcoming, attentive, responsive, and professional. They take the time to explain everything thoroughly.

They called me and took the time to give me an update after my cat's tooth extraction (under general anesthesia) 🩷

Furthermore, I want to emphasize the transparency and professionalism of this clinic.

Every procedure discussed during the consultation (blood test, injections, extraction, etc.) was explained and a cost estimate was provided before anything was done.

Thank you for everything; you're my new go-to vet clinic in Paris 🩷
Thank you to the entire hospital team and to Dr. Denizet. You were all incredibly kind and everyone on the team did their best for our cat.

Our cat has been a patient at this clinic for several years.

When he became very ill (repeated vomiting), the receptionist downplayed his condition, saying it was due to the heat, which delayed the diagnosis.

We went to another clinic, which diagnosed a tumor after analysis. They performed emergency surgery.
After the operation, we wanted to have the stitches removed at this clinic, and once again, we were met with a very poor reception from the receptionist, who clearly questioned the competence of the veterinarian at the other clinic who operated on our cat. We were also unable to schedule an appointment with them.
A very, very bad experience, I do not recommend it!
A kind and competent team, thank you for taking care of my dog.
A very pleasant team, who take the time to get to know the animals, who are attentive and available

The entire team is truly lovely and efficiently resolved my cat's health issues (surgeries, treatments, follow-up) with great care and kindness.
I highly recommend this clinic!

I want to commend the work of the entire team who tirelessly care for our furry friends. A genuine warmth and humanity are evident here, which is precious and rare these days! Our animals are in good hands, and I recommend this clinic without hesitation.

My dog ​​is seen here by Dr. Denizet, who is amazing. I recently had my dog ​​spayed; the operation went perfectly, the scar was flawless, and the follow-up care was excellent. Dr. Denizet is always incredibly gentle, especially with my little girl, who is a bit timid. I highly recommend him.

Amazing!!! ♥️♥️♥️ Three truly wonderful female vets 🌷🌷 They've saved my cat twice since January 2025... They are so kind and attentive... I can't thank them enough 🍀🍀🍀💗💗💗💗 Thank you, thank you, thank you so much 🙏💕💕
Stella and Bella …

Thank you to all the staff at the clinic where I've had the pleasure of taking my dog ​​for the past 15 years.

Special mention to Dr. Denizet, who has always been attentive, kind, and very caring. All the best, and I look forward to seeing you again.
Dr. Sauvaget was wonderful with my Shiba. Listening, kindness, attentiveness, and gentleness were the hallmarks of this consultation. I highly recommend him 😊 …
Lovely staff and effective care 👍🇫🇷👌. …

Kind, welcoming women who explain everything with a smile.

Thank you for Gourdon.

Idiots. Several visits, roughly 600 euros. Full of judgment. Despite numerous dermatological and ENT treatments, they kept making comments and questioning my dog's adherence to the treatment and how well I was being treated. Another vet …

Terrible vet! After neutering my mother's cat, the stitches didn't hold (no cone was provided). As a result, the cat's organs were hanging out.
The vet refuses to admit his mistake, and we had to pay for another operation. I advise you to avoid them at all costs.
September 2020: Excellent staff, first consultation for little Kaïs, warm welcome, very affordable price. I highly recommend these professionals. …
Excellent clinic

My "little" beagle has been under the care of Dr. Denizet and his team for over three years. In addition to his excellent care and availability, we can only appreciate his responsiveness and kindness in all circumstances.
